caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornately carved wooden table with an octagonal top. The table is shown at an angle, giving a view of the surface and the details of the base. The tabletop is predominantly shades of warm brown, with orange and yellow highlights reflecting light, and features a beveled edge with a decorative apron below. The apron is adorned with a series of evenly spaced, small vertical projections. The base of the table consists of one central pedestal that splits into three highly decorative, curved legs. The pedestal and legs display intricate carved foliage and scrollwork patterns, rendered in deep reddish-brown hues with areas of lighter brown and subtle highlights to suggest the play of light on polished wood. The table is presented against a plain, light beige or off-white background with no additional objects or decorative elements present. The artist's signature and the year "1947" appear in the lower left corner of the drawing.
title: Carved Mahogany Table
